name: Sleeping imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, fast asleep, curled up on its back in the air with its wings folded round it like a blanket, snoring with its mouth open, a bubble of smoke at its nose

poses.stand: curled up asleep on its back, wings wrapped round it, snoring, a little smoke bubble at its nose
poses.struck: startled awake mid-snore, eyes bulging, wings flung out
poses.dead: tumbling over in a puff of soot

idle.action: sleeps, its belly rising and falling with each snore, the smoke bubble at its nose growing and shrinking

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
